records.author: user
records.text: Buy one prepaid, indivisible travel package for six people numbered 0 through 5. The discount groups are (0,1), (2,3), and (4,5). Only one catalog package can be chosen today. The package cannot subsequently be changed based on who actually cancels, and terms from different packages cannot be combined.

records.author: user
records.text: There may subsequently be no cancellations, or any set of at most four people may cancel. Every specific cancellation set that satisfies the limit on the number of people is possible, with no other dependence restrictions or probabilities. Each person who cancels incurs the individual unrecoverable loss listed in their loss field; these loss amounts exclude group discount clawbacks. A discount group has its discount amount clawed back once only when exactly one person cancels. When both people in a group cancel together, the group discount is restored along with the refund for the whole group, and that group discount is no longer clawed back; both people's individual loss amounts are still included as usual. There is also no clawback when no one cancels. Each discount group is settled separately according to its own actual number of cancellations. The total loss for the whole order is the sum of the loss amounts for all people who cancel, plus the discount amounts that actually must be clawed back; there are no other charges.

records.author: user
records.text: All amounts are nonnegative integers in fen of RMB. price is at least the total sum of all six loss fields and all three fee fields, ensuring that the total loss in each event does not exceed the original payment. The original payment must not exceed 1200000 fen of RMB; in every permitted cancellation event, the total loss for the whole order must not exceed 200000 fen of RMB.

records.author: user
records.text: In each event, utility is 2000000 minus the original payment price, then minus the total loss for the whole order in that event.
